title: Characters may be lost during confirmation when using the "on-the-spot" style IME preedit on X11
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in master (0b3dc97fb)

### System information

Godot v4.7.dev (0b3dc97fb) - Linux Mint 22.3 (Zena) on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - AMD Radeon 780M Graphics (radeonsi, phoenix, LLVM 20.1.2, DRM 3.64, 6.17.0-20-generic) - AMD Ryzen 7 8745H w/ Radeon 780M Graphics (16 threads) - 25.22 GiB memory

### Issue description

When typing Chinese characters using an IME with "On The Spot Style" enabled, characters may be dropped, as shown below:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ad1468bc-b780-42ab-b95e-d7a6eb8edd3d

This occurs in both ibus-libpinyin (version: 1.15.7-1build2, IBus 1.5.29-rc2, more frequently) and fcitx5-rime (version: 5.1.4-2build2, Fcitx5 5.1.7). 

According to [Synchronization Conventions](https://www.x.org/releases/current/doc/libX11/libX11/libX11.html#Synchronization_Conventions) in Xlib - C Language X Interface:

> A KeyPress event with a KeyCode of zero is used exclusively as a signal that an input method has composed input that can be returned by [XmbLookupString](https://www.x.org/releases/current/doc/libX11/libX11/libX11.html#XmbLookupString) or [XwcLookupString](https://www.x.org/releases/current/doc/libX11/libX11/libX11.html#XwcLookupString). No other use is made of a KeyPress event with KeyCode of zero.

I examined the timing of the `_xim_preedit_done_callback()` call and the event with keycode `0`. 

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/1aabcb9e9bc7a222a972731523831ec86b77ee20/platform/linuxbsd/x11/display_server_x11.cpp#L4455-L4458

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/1aabcb9e9bc7a222a972731523831ec86b77ee20/platform/linuxbsd/x11/display_server_x11.cpp#L3940-L3948

Preedit words are dropped when the event (keycode `0`) is processed **before** the callback is invoked. Otherwise, the text will be entered normally.

This is not the same issue as #116478.



### Steps to reproduce

1. Enable the On The Spot Style for the IME, and then restart the IME.
    - IBus: 
        - Run `ibus-setup` and enable **Embed preedit text in application window** on the **General** tab of the popup.
    - Fcitx5: 
        - In the **Fcitx Configuration** window, find the **X Input Method Frontend** in the **Addons** tab and configure it. In the pop-up window, check **Use On The Spot Style (Needs restarting)**.
        - **Rime** should also be configured in the **Input Method** tab. In the pop-up window, change the **Preedit Mode** to "Commit preview".
2. Typing Chinese characters in a `TextEdit` or `LineEdit` in Godot.
3. Press the **number** key or the `Space` key to confirm the candidate word. This issue is more easily reproducible if the confirmation key is held down for a slightly longer duration, or when Chinese characters are being typed relatively quickly overall.
4. Repeat Step 3 and observe.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

N/A
